name: read-your-writes
body:
A subsequent query in a NEW process sees the mutation immediately. The reader shares no in-memory state with the writer and needs no prior coordination: it may be a fresh `apg query` process started after the mutation returned. This is the read-your-writes guarantee for an external reader.

Acceptance: `apg node add … foo` returns, then a new `apg query` process resolving `foo` returns it — no re-scan, no explicit flush, no session-end, no shared session state.
